sonnet.problem: Tells God's promise as if it is happening now: "Then God places the key to the house of David on his shoulder" and "Eliakim just got the BEST title." The text says "I will place," and "he will be a father."
sonnet.rule: A prediction stays a prediction: "God says Tyre will fall," never "Tyre falls."

sonnet.problem: "Everything goes on him" tells the prediction in verse 24 as if it is happening now. The text says "they will hang on him."
sonnet.rule: A prediction stays a prediction: "God says Tyre will fall," never "Tyre falls."

sonnet.problem: "It's sheared off and falls, and the load on it is cut down" tells the prediction in verse 25 as if it is happening now. The text says "will give way; it will be sheared off and fall."
sonnet.rule: A prediction stays a prediction: "God says Tyre will fall," never "Tyre falls."
